1.w: Therefore, be imitators of God as dearly loved children

2.w: and live in love, just as Christ also loved us and gave himself for us, a sacrificial and fragrant offering to God.

3.w: But among you there must not be either sexual immorality, impurity of any kind, or greed, as these are not fitting for the saints.

4.w: Neither should there be vulgar speech, foolish talk, or coarse jesting—all of which are out of character—but rather thanksgiving.

5.w: For you can be confident of this one thing: that no person who is immoral, impure, or greedy (such a person is an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.

6.w: Let nobody deceive you with empty words, for because of these things God’s wrath comes on the sons of disobedience.

7.w: Therefore do not be sharers with them,

8.w: for you were at one time darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Live like children of light—

9.w: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth—

10.w: trying to learn what is pleasing to the Lord.

11.w: Do not participate in the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.

12.w: For the things they do in secret are shameful even to mention.

13.w: But all things being exposed by the light are made visible.

14.w: For everything made visible is light, and for this reason it says: “Awake, O sleeper! Rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you!”

15.w: Therefore consider carefully how you live—not as unwise but as wise,

16.w: taking advantage of every opportunity because the days are evil.

17.w: For this reason do not be foolish, but be wise by understanding what the Lord’s will is.

18.w: And do not get drunk with wine, which is debauchery, but be filled by the Spirit,

19.w: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing and making music in your hearts to the Lord,

20.w: always giving thanks to God the Father for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ,

21.w: and submitting to one another out of reverence for Christ.

22.w: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord,

23.w: because the husband is the head of the wife as also Christ is the head of the church (he himself being the savior of the body).

24.w: But as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.

25.w: Husbands, love your wives just as Christ loved the church and gave himself for her

26.w: to sanctify her by cleansing her with the washing of the water by the word,

27.w: so that he may present the church to himself as glorious—not having a stain or wrinkle, or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.

28.w: In the same way husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.

29.w: For no one has ever hated his own body, but he feeds it and takes care of it, just as Christ also does the church,

30.w: because we are members of his body.

31.w: For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.

32.w: This mystery is great—but I am actually speaking with reference to Christ and the church.

33.w: Nevertheless, each one of you must also love his own wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
